name: Syntranova AI Model Photos for WooCommerce
author: syntranova

sections.description:
Photo shoots with models are slow and expensive. The ateliernoir.ai service by Syntranova turns the photo you already have (flat lay, mannequin or packshot) into editorial photos on a model, in the setting you choose, and this plugin brings it into WooCommerce:

  • “Create model photos” button on every product
  • Bulk action: create photos for up to 20 selected products at once
  • Choose the model and the setting from the ateliernoir.ai library, or let them be chosen automatically
  • Finished photos are added to the product gallery automatically, labelled as AI-generated
  • 1 to 8 photos per product

You need an ateliernoir.ai account with a plan that includes API access. Each photo uses one frame from your plan.

External services

This plugin connects to the ateliernoir.ai API (https://ateliernoir.ai/api/v1/) from your WordPress server, using the API key you enter:

  • In the settings page, it reads the model and setting libraries (GET /models, GET /sets).
  • When you click “Create model photos” or use the bulk action, it sends the public address of the product’s main image, the product name and your chosen options (POST /generations). The service downloads that image to create the photos.
  • Every 2 minutes, while a job is running, it checks the job (GET /generations/{id}) and downloads the finished photos from ateliernoir.ai into your Media Library.

Nothing is loaded from ateliernoir.ai on your public store pages. The service is provided by Syntranova AL Ltd: Terms of service, Privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then this plugin.
  2. Create your account at https://ateliernoir.ai/ and create an API key in the studio (Settings → API keys).
  3. Go to WooCommerce → AI Model Photos, paste the key and choose your defaults.
  4. Open a product with an image and click “Create model photos”.
sections.faq:
Which photos work best?

A clear photo of the garment: flat lay, on a mannequin or a packshot on a plain background.

How long does it take?

Usually a few minutes. The photos appear in the product gallery when they are ready.

Will a dress be shown on a woman and a suit on a man?

Yes. Products whose name, categories or tags say they are for men (Men, Bărbați, Herren, Homme, Hombre, Uomo and more) get a man model; everything else gets a woman model. You can pick a fixed model for each in the settings, or adjust the detection with the synamp_product_gender filter.

My images are on a CDN or private storage

Use the synamp_image_url filter to send a public address of the product image.

Are the photos marked as AI-generated?

Yes. The image title says “AI-generated model photo”.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • The model now matches the product: men’s products (from the name, categories or tags, in many languages) get a man model, everything else a woman model.
  • Separate model choice for women’s and men’s products in the settings.
  • The product screen shows which model will be used.
  • New filters: synamp_product_gender and synamp_image_url.

1.0.0

  • First release.
